lessons.title: Health and Wellbeing — A1
lessons.learn: Use short Gujarati sentences for basic recognition and respectful interaction. Gujarati is normally subject–object–verb and marks relationships with endings or postpositions. Apply the skill to health & doctor with age-appropriate, respectful forms.

grammar.title: Health and Wellbeing structures
grammar.explain: Use short Gujarati sentences for basic recognition and respectful interaction. Gujarati is normally subject–object–verb and marks relationships with endings or postpositions. Gujarati verbs and adjectives may show gender and number, while case relations and politeness shape natural word choice.
grammar.pattern: context + marked participants + object/complement + finite verb
mistakes: Do not copy English word order; Gujarati is normally verb-final. Keep gender, number, postpositions, and respectful તમે (tamē) consistent.

alphabet.title: Gujarati Script Foundations
alphabet.explain: Devanagari's sister with NO headline bar — the letters hang free. If you read Hindi, you'll decode Gujarati fast; a few letters (ખ ગ જ ટ ણ ફ) look different enough to learn fresh.

counting.title: Gujarati Numbers
counting.explain: Gujarati counts directly — number + noun, no classifier words:
rules: Learn one to twenty as complete forms.
A numeral normally comes before the noun it counts.
